programme.title: Valley Girl
programme.desc: Dans cette adaptation du classique de 83, Julie (Jessica Rothe) incarne parfaitement la petite fille parfaite qui voit son univers bouleversé lorsqu'elle tombe amoureuse de Randy (Josh Whitehouse), un punk rocker d'Hollywood !

programme.title: Sexy movie
programme.desc: Romantique absolue, Julia Jones a toujours cru au Grand Amour. Lorsqu'elle rencontre enfin l'Homme De Sa Vie, le très british Grant Funkyerdoder, elle croit tenir le bon bout. Mais c'est sans compter sur le retour d' Andy, l'ex de Grant, une vraie bombe sexuelle...

programme.title: Love over distance
programme.desc: Evie a la trentaine, ambitieuse elle est prête à vivre la promotion de sa vie : un job à Rio de Janeiro ! Son petit ami a déjà fait ses valises, mais il s'avère que son patron a prévu des plans différents pour elle. Evie va être en charge d'un gros projet à Terneuzen, une petite ville de Hollande.

programme.title: Love, Romance & Chocolate
programme.desc: Emma et le chocolatier Luc concourent pour le titre de Chocolatier Rayal de Belgique. La beauté et le romantisme de Bruges inspirent des combinaisons de chocolats uniques, mais gagneront-t-ils sans qu'ils y perdent leur cœur ?

programme.title: La vie de bohème
programme.desc: Tous sont des artistes (peintres, musiciens, poètes...), tous sont destinés à la gloire, ce sont les beaux jours, la jeunesse. C'est La Vie De Bohême, la vie bohémienne. Mimi et Rodolphe se promènent dans les Jardins du Luxembourg. C'est le printemps. L'été apporte la Révolution de 1848. Rodolphe, le poète, est très déçu car personne ne veut publier ses vers. L'automne marque le début des mauvais jours. Les amis n'ont rien à brûler dans leur cheminée sauf eux-mêmes. Mimi a quitté Rodolphe car elle ne veut pas être un fardeau pour lui. En hiver, alors que la neige tombe, les amis fêtent Noël Mimi est devenue une femme entretenue elle est mourante et elle est toujours amoureuse de Rodolphe.

programme.title: The Perfect Man(icure)
programme.desc: L'inventrice excentrique Katya s'associe au consultant en marketing charismatique et sûr de lui, Ryan, pour l'aider à vendre son appareil de manucure personnel, Phenomenails, lors du prochain Salon de la Beauté.

programme.title: Stolen from the Suburbs
programme.desc: est une mère célibataire qui mène une vie tranquille en banlieue avec sa fille adolescente de 16 ans, Emma. Un soir, après avoir quitté discrètement la maison pour un rendez-vous, Emma est enlevée et intégrée de force dans un réseau criminel de traite d'êtres humains.

programme.title: L'Aventure du Dr Fergus
programme.desc: Comédie sur un dentiste américain (Daniel Day-Lewis) parcourant la campagne argentine à moto pour prêcher l'évangile de l'hygiène dentaire.

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Run s'enfuit… Il vient de tuer le Premier ministre de son pays. Pour cela il a dû prendre le visage et les vêtements d'un fou, errant à travers la ville. Sa vie lui revient par flashes son enfance avec maître Tourou quand il rêvait de devenir faiseur de pluie, ses aventures avec Gladys la mangeuse et son passé de milicien en tant que Jeune Patriote, au cœur du conflit politique et militaire en Côte d'Ivoire. Toutes ses vies, Run ne les a pas choisies. À chaque fois, il s'est laissé happer par elles, en fuyant une vie précédente. C'est pour ça qu'il s'appelle Run.

programme.title: Un hologramme pour le roi
programme.desc: Un homme accepte le job de sa vie dans le but de vendre une technologie d'hologramme à un monarque.

programme.title: Opération Lidice
programme.desc: Le 27 mai 1942, à Prague, l'officier SS Reinhard Heydrich est victime d'un attentat organisé par la résistance

programme.title: The Neighbor
programme.desc: Un homme d'âge moyen voit sa vie bouleversée par une jolie jeune femme.

programme.title: Walt Avant Mickey
programme.desc: Walt Disney surmonte les obstacles de son enfance, créant Mickey Mouse et un empire légendaire.

programme.title: Flirt et passe-passe
programme.desc: Lors d'un séjour à Trinité-et-Tobago, deux jumelles identiques sont prises l'une pour l'autre par leurs prétendants respectifs. En jouant le jeu, elles découvrent que l'amour pourrait les mener là où elles ne l'attendaient pas.

programme.title: Coup de foudre au restaurant
programme.desc: Ariel, journaliste spécialisée en bien-être, cherche à retrouver l'homme de ses rêves aperçu dans un restaurant. Mais sa quête la rapproche surtout de Daniel, un séduisant restaurateur qui pourrait conquérir son cœur.

programme.title: La recette de l'amour
programme.desc: Suit Lia qui peine à développer son service de livraison de repas à but non lucratif parce qu'elle insiste pour tout faire elle-même, mais avec l'aide d'Eli, elle découvre que les affaires, tout comme les romances, peuvent fleurir avec un peu d'effort et de confiance.

programme.title: Les Regrets
programme.desc: Mathieu Lievin, 40 ans, architecte parisien, prend la route pour rejoindre la petite ville de son enfance où sa mère vient d'être hospitalisée en urgence. Dans la rue, il croise Maya, son amour de jeunesse, qu'il n'a pas revue depuis quinze années. Accompagnée d'un homme et d'une petite fille, elle ne lui adresse pas la parole. Deux heures plus tard, le téléphone sonne dans la maison familiale : c'est Maya qui l'invite à venir la retrouver chez elle. Il hésite un court instant puis accepte..

programme.title: L'amour dans l'oreillette
programme.desc: Sam, coach en amour réputée à Los Angeles, guide ses clients pendant leurs rendez-vous. Mais lorsque Mattie remet en cause ses méthodes, Sam découvre que le véritable amour ne suit peut-être aucune règle.

programme.title: Chevalier
programme.desc: Bien qu'il ne soit pas noble et donc qu'il n'ait pas le droit de participer aux joutes des chevaliers, l'intrépide William décide de prendre son destin en main en remplaçant au pied levé le seigneur dont il est l'écuyer, décédé tragiquement quelques jours avant le fameux tournoi qui doit réunir tous les chevaliers du territoire.

programme.title: Rien Que Pour Vos Cheveux
programme.desc: Agent d'élite du Mossad et véritable star dans son pays, Zohan (Adam Sandler) rêve de devenir coiffeur en Amérique. Profitant d'un combat contre son pire ennemi, connu sous le nom de Fantôme, Zohan se fait passer pour mort et s'envole pour New York armé uniquement de ses ciseaux et de son sèche-cheveux. Malgré son inexpérience, il est engagé par la patronne d'un salon de coiffure, une jolie Palestinienne. Alors que son passé d'agent semble loin derrière lui, Zohan est repéré par le Fantôme, qui compte bien en finir avec lui une bonne fois pour toutes...

programme.title: Rien Que Pour Vos Cheveux
programme.desc: Agent d'élite du Mossad et véritable star dans son pays, Zohan (Adam Sandler) rêve de devenir coiffeur en Amérique. Profitant d'un combat contre son pire ennemi, connu sous le nom de Fantôme, Zohan se fait passer pour mort et s'envole pour New York armé uniquement de ses ciseaux et de son sèche-cheveux. Malgré son inexpérience, il est engagé par la patronne d'un salon de coiffure, une jolie Palestinienne. Alors que son passé d'agent semble loin derrière lui, Zohan est repéré par le Fantôme, qui compte bien en finir avec lui une bonne fois pour toutes...

programme.title: Step Brothers
programme.desc: Deux garçons gâtés l'un par sa mère, l'autre par son père, deviennent demi-frères quand leurs parents tombent amoureux et se marient.

programme.title: Toy Boy
programme.desc: Son job, c'est donner du plaisir!

programme.title: Allumeuses!
programme.desc: Trois amies croquent la vie à pleines dents et n'ont pas besoin d'hommes pour être heureuses. Jusqu'au jour où l'une d'entre elles tombe amoureuse... Christina s'est toujours efforcée de respecter une règle d'or en matière de mecs: "Eviter toute relation sérieuse avec le sexe opposé".

programme.title: Hitch
programme.desc: New York "date doctor" Alex Hitchens (Will Smith) tries to charm gossip columnist Sara Melas (Eva Mendes) at the same time he is coaching shy Albert (Kevin James) on how to win the love of beautiful heiress Allegra Cole (Amber Valletta).

programme.title: La machine à démonter le temps
programme.desc: Préparez-vous à botter le passé avec "La machine à démonter le temps !" Les rires délirants éclatent lorsque quatre amis partagent une nuit folle à boire dans un jacuzzi de station de ski, pour se réveiller avec une gueule de bois atroce... en 1986.

programme.title: Demande pardon à Dieu, pas à moi...
programme.desc: Alors que Cjamango est absent de son ranch, six bandits attaquent et tuent tous les membres de sa famille. Bouleversé par cette tragédie, il entreprend de se venger.

programme.title: Quatre salopards pour Garringo
programme.desc: Une bande de malfaiteurs braque un convoi transportant de l'or destiné au Trésor public. Cette nuit-là, Farley vole l'or, mais on le retrouve mort le lendemain matin.

programme.title: Duel au Texas
programme.desc: Un étranger en quête de vengeance fait une véritable carnage parmi une bande de bandits impitoyables pour venger le meurtre de sa famille.

programme.title: La dernière balle à pile ou face
programme.desc: Un hors-la-loi sauve une jeune femme d'une mort certaine et décide de se venger de ses bourreaux.

programme.title: La vallée de la peur
programme.desc: Dans les années 1880, un garçon hanté par des cauchemars sur la nuit où toute sa famille a été assassinée est élevé par une famille voisine.

programme.title: SCALPS
programme.desc: Le colonel confédéré Connor a refusé de se rendre après la fin de la guerre de Sécession. Il tombe amoureux de Yari, la fille du chef indien voisin de son fort. Lorsque le chef indien refuse de lui céder sa fille, il fait massacrer les habitants du camp et enlever Yari.

programme.title: Les Chercheurs d'or de l'Arkansas
programme.desc: Basé sur le roman de Friedrich Gerstäcker, le film, entièrement situé dans l'État de l'Arkansas, raconte le conflit d'intérêts entre les habitants locaux et les colons sur les terres environnantes, les mineurs arrivant pendant la ruée vers l'or, les cowboys et les voleurs de bétail qui causent des problèmes dans la région, et les tribus autochtones de la région. Deux aventuriers arrivent en ville et tentent de rétablir la paix pour elle et ses habitants.

programme.title: On m'appelle King
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes traque un gang vicieux de trafiquants d'armes à travers la frontière jusqu'au Mexique.

programme.title: Le Géant de Métropolis
programme.desc: Muscleman Ohro se rend dans la capitale pécheresse de l'Atlantide pour réprimander son impiété et son orgueil, et s'engage dans la bataille contre son seigneur maléfique Yoh-tar et ses plans hideux de super-science.

programme.title: The Deal
programme.desc: Une pandémie sans précédent a ravagé la planète. Pour combattre la crise, un corps dirigeant totalitaire, le Bureau, a établi "Le Deal". Acceptez-le et vous recevrez emploi, logement et soins médicaux pendant vingt ans, après quoi vous devrez vous suicider.

programme.title: Perfect Weapon
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, un agent-assassin d'une organisation secrète au service d'un gouvernement totalitaire échoue dans une mission et doit fuir ses employeurs.

programme.title: Enlèvement
programme.desc: À la recherche d'une femme disparue dans le Dakota du Nord, un agent du FBI et un shérif se concentrent sur son mari, un fanatique religieux, mais découvrent quelque chose de bien plus sinistre.

programme.title: Project : Affinity
programme.desc: Un ancien Navy SEAL souffrant de stress post-traumatique sauve une femme puis en tombe amoureux, avant de la perdre aux mains de mystérieux ravisseurs.

programme.title: Bloody Sand
programme.desc: Lors d'une apocalypse zombie, une femme au passé trouble originaire de Las Vegas se retrouve acculée dans le désert avec un zombie solitaire et affamé à ses trousses.

programme.title: Invasion Planète Terre: L'Ordre et la loi
programme.desc: Rho'ha est jugé pour meurtre par un tribunal humain, avec Joshua Doors chargé de l'accusation.

programme.title: Vol 732: Terreur en plein ciel
programme.desc: Un ancien négociateur du FBI tente de sauver un avion pour Los Angeles menacé par une bombe terroriste.

programme.title: Robocroc
programme.desc: Après le crash d'une fusée, des nanorobots fusionnent avec un crocodile et le transforment en prédateur incontrôlable.

programme.title: Earth VS the Spider
programme.desc: Un passionné de comics reçoit un sérum qui lui donne des capacités d'arachnide.

programme.title: Robert the Bruce
programme.desc: Suite de Braveheart et inspiré de faits réels épiques, le film raconte l'histoire d'un noble devenu hors-la-loi, héros qui fut couronné roi d'Écosse au XIVe siècle.

programme.title: Poppy Jamie: There's No Such Thing As Coincidence
programme.desc: Entrepreneur and author Poppy Jamie discusses intuition, coincidence, and inner wisdom with Fearne Cotton. They explore why collective exhaustion stems from trusting logic over gut instinct, and how inexplicable moments expand our understanding of what's possible. Poppy shares her near-infertility diagnosis and how belief in magic, intuition, and the support of wise women have helped her cope.

programme.title: Perrie Edwards On The Cost Of Fame
programme.desc: A panic attack can feel like you're dying from a heart attack this is something former Little Mix member Perrie Edwards has experienced numerous times over the last few years. Perrie talks about how her anxiety feels like her adult is 'going offline', leaving the child in her crying for help.

programme.title: Michelle Keegan On Imposter Syndrome, Boundaries, And Puzzles
programme.desc: Imposter syndrome is likely to affect all of us at some point in our life Michelle Keegan still feels it every time she finishes an acting job. In this chat with Fearne, Michelle talks about her disciplined work ethic, as well as how she's learnt to cope well with the amount of rejection in her industry. They also chat about why setting boundaries – especially drawing lines between personal and professional life – is so important. Plus, they wonder why it still feels important in adulthood to seek validation from our parents.

programme.title: Monty Don: Why Doing Nothing Isn't How He Switches Off
programme.desc: What does a truly restful holiday look like? Horticulturalist Monty Don relaxes most when he knows the drill: same Greek island, same terrace for breakfast, same collapsible travel kettle packed. In this chat with Fearne, Monty explains the difference between all the globe-trotting he does for work and a proper switching-off holiday. They discuss the excitement of stepping off a plane into an entirely different culture, as well as why you won't find either of them staying up late for a social dinner.

programme.title: Miquita Oliver: "I Thought I Hated You Fearne"
programme.desc: Back in the noughties, Miquita Oliver thought Fearne Cotton was an irritatingly gorgeous, successful presenter - everything she wasn't. Fearne was jealous Miquita was part of the TV cool gang. In reality, Fearne worried she was an unsophisticated nerd, while Miquita was feeling like the fat, ugly sidekick. Live from the Happy Place Festival.

programme.title: Matt Edmondson & Mollie King On Imposter Syndrome & Finding Your Voice
programme.desc: Fearne Cotton talks with Radio 1 presenters Matt Edmondson and Mollie King about self-doubt, imposter syndrome, and the power of supportive friendships. From Mollie's memories of struggling to read out loud at school to Matt's experience of feeling like an imposter when he first joined Radio 1, they explore the inner critic so many of us live with.

programme.title: Julian Clary On Easing Anxiety
programme.desc: Can laughter ease anxiety? Comedian Julian Clary certainly thinks so. After living some incredibly dark events and anxious times, he's decided to choose to laugh and think positive thoughts. In this chat with Fearne, Julian talks about feeling naturally happier and more comfortable in his skin as he got older. Most things, he says, just aren't as important as you think they are, and that's a freeing realisation.

programme.title: Louise Redknapp On Coping With Loneliness And Low Self-Esteem
programme.desc: Singer Louise Redknapp discusses feeling pressure to be the 'good girl' after years in a 90s girlband and marriage to a sports star, which left her afraid of saying or doing the wrong thing. She explores how not knowing her dad and becoming a mother have impacted her confidence and identity, and shares how she's learning to trust her own gut instinct and embrace different facets of her character.

programme.title: The Woman Who Loves Giraffes
programme.desc: Dr. Anne Innis Dagg re-traces the steps of her ground-breaking 1956 journey to South Africa to study giraffes in the wild. Now, at 85 years old, Anne sees a startling contrast between the world of giraffes she once knew and the one it has become. Weaving through the past and present, her harrowing journey gives us an intimate look into the factors that destroyed her career and the forces that brought her back.

programme.title: The Return of the Osprey
programme.desc: The Osprey is the only raptor in the world to feed exclusively on fish. This migratory bird has lived throughout central Europe for a long time, nesting there in the summer months. But the species has gradually moved to more northerly regions of the continent, far from the persecution caused by human expansion. Wendy and Denis have set launched an ambitious challenge of reintroducing the Osprey to Switzerland, a century after its disappearance.

programme.title: Wild Waters
programme.desc: From the highest mountain to the lowest valley, rivers and streams are freshwater highways, de-livering essential life blood to all kinds of wildlife. From some of the most iconic species like the otter and the trout, to the unfamiliar and elusive, like the delicate harvest mouse. Life on these freshwater freeways can be tough, and for many it's a constant battle just to stay alive. Take a break from the oceans and turn to the rivers and streams, home to the real wild waters of the nat-ural world.

programme.title: Spots and Stripes
programme.desc: Whether spots or stripes, markings can be used for anything from communication to cooling. What look like standout fashion statements to us can help animals vanish completely into a landscape. The design possibilities are endless, and vary to suit the terrain and geography. Whatever their remarkable uses, spots and stripes adorn some of the most iconic animals in the natural world. Camouflage or decoration, we can thank both spots and stripes for handing these creatures their unique and majestic beauty.

programme.title: Nature's Weirdest
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most – scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on. Each one finds its own way to exploit and conserve the available food and water in a daily struggle for survival.

programme.title: Seasons Of The Otter
programme.desc: Most of the life of an otter goes unseen following a young otter family we'll reveal the secrets of the otter's world.

programme.title: Tropical (Kingdom's of the Sun)
programme.desc: The tropics can be found in the band around the centre of the Earth. This position shapes dramatic landscapes and a range of challenges to all who live there. Tropics are perhaps best known for rainforests thanks to the extensive rains and lush, fruiting vegetation, these exhibit the greatest biodiversity of any habitat on the planet. The tropics aren't just about rainforests, however. They also support remarkable grasslands and even deserts, where yet more incredible flora and fauna can be found.

programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S2 E01
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads

programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world's ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn's house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver's personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Wild Poland
programme.desc: Where in Europe are bisons still to be found in the wild? And where do probably more migratory birds breed than in any other European country? The flora and fauna of Poland are full of surprises: the South is dominated by the 2000m peaks of the Tatra, to the North-East the Biebrza river forms one of the largest swamp regions of Europe, a paradise for rare birds like the ruff. Masuria is the breeding-ground for thousands of white storks, more than anywhere else on Earth. The much shier and rarer black stork also finds refuge in the large expanses of forest that stretch to the Baltic Sea. In winter, an icy wind sweeps Eastern Poland and only those with a thick skin survive in the region bordering Belorus. The cold doesn't bother the bison. Thick coats protect these ancient cattle against the snow and icy wind, but lack of food in winter does present a problem. The bison here are among the last of their kind. Once upon a time, huge herds roamed most of the European continent, today the only bison in Central Europe living in the wild are located in Eastern Poland. Poland's hard winters are no problem for otter and beaver, whose extremely dense coats protect them against the cold and enable them to swim and dive in the icy water. Although both animals are water-dwellers, they're not rivals: beavers are vegetarians and in winter eat stores of leaves and bark. Otters are active hunters all year round and live on fish and crabs. As soon as spring arrives in Poland, the river Biebrza becomes a hive of activity: thousands of birds vie with each other to be heard as they use the vast area of swampland to rest and breed. White-winged black terns and black-necked grebes build their nests, then the mating season begins for the ruffs, with the males strutting their stuff for potential mates.

programme.title: The Grateful Dud

But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.title: Masha's Songs

programme.desc: It happens that grown-up people have their own fears! For example, one grandmother was very afraid not to please her grandson. Whatever she cooked- nothing was good enough for him. Once she tried to give him a tomato, but he just threw it towards the wall! Grandma was very upset and left the house. And so he was left alone and scared- there was no one home! Much fear he had suffered until his grandmother came back! This terrible trick taught him a worthy lesson so nevertheless he was cranky ever after and ate with a terrible appetite!

But in reality it's so simple to ride a bike without any worries...isn't it?

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.307
programme.desc: FRankly is made up of vocalist and guitarist Jung Seung-Hwan, guitarist Na Hyung-chul, drummer Ato, and bassist Koo Dong-uk. Deeply inspired by the 2000s Brit pop and American alternative rock, their music encapsulates authentic retro sentiments. However, they also display their trademark, youthful energy in many other elements of their musical work, such as album covers and song descriptions, making everyone fall for their kaleidoscopic qualities.In this episode, FRankly performs “TR,” “Grow Up!,” “DD (Drunk Dreaming,” “Help me,” and their latest single “Novel.”

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.308
programme.desc: In this episode, BAND NAH performs “Shine,” which they released early this year, “Love Love Love,” Spotlight“ featured on the sound88ack of ”Yumi's Cells,“ ”88,“ and ”1+1“ to showcase the essence of their musicality.BAND NAH is comprised of guitarist and vocalist Nah Sang-hyun, drummer Kang Hyun-woong, and bassist PAIIEK. This 88io debuted in 2015 with the EP, “Tingling,” and has released about 90 songs since then. Impressively enough, their music is as diverse as it is prolific. They have been evolving in unpredictable ways every time while maintaining their delightful spirit - no wonder why they are highly sought after for concerts and festivals.

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.310
programme.desc: In this episode, Isaac Hong X Sooyoung Chin performs their songs “(n)everland,” “a bird,” “pages,” and also Hong's own pieces “Rain” and “Stay.”Joining us on this week's episode of I'm LIVE is Isaac Hong X Sooyoung Chin!Isaac Hong made himself known to the public with his Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest-winning self-written song “Spring” in 2013. Since then, he has steadily built up his own musical world, marked by his trademark, mellow vocals and delicate sentiments. This time, he collaborated with renowned jazz pianist Sooyoung Chin to drop their project album, “Everland.” It is a mostly English-language album made through months of full collaboration, and the two describe it as “a record of their conversations over piano.” Using the common language of music, the two expanded their reach into each other's respective universes. Tune in to I'm LIVE and join their beautiful jazzy conversation!

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: Pain Threshold
